Little was known about '''Katak Crystals''' or their origins. They were generally only found in the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] users. Users of this lightsaber crystal managed to drain some of the life force of those within close vicinity. This would not be enough to instantly fatigue the victim, however; prolonged exposure would prove to be fatal.

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' this is a [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] unlocked by finding the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] above the highest [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] beam in the incomplete [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. Equipping the crystal allows some lightsaber attacks to siphon portions of an opponent's remaining health to the player.
